purpose: Test a licensed regional HydroLAKES v1 subset as a faster inland-water discovery layer and screen one unnamed polygon candidate near Lake Sampaloc. This is not a complete Philippine waterbody inventory.

sources.publishedReference: Lehner, B. and Messager, M.L. (2016). HydroLAKES: Global Lake and Reservoir Database. Environmental Data Initiative.

sources.creator: Daniel Schönberger
sources.access: Downloaded from Zenodo and verified against the record's published MD5. The full official HydroLAKES global archive was not downloaded.

subsetScreen.interpretation: No polygon has a Lake_name value containing Sampaloc. This is a bounded name-field screen, not evidence that the lake or its polygon is absent.

localityScreen.waterbodyLead: Lake Sampaloc, San Pablo City, Laguna

approximateQueryCenter.basis: Approximate discovery point only; not a source-reported survey coordinate or a validated lake centroid.

localityScreen.geometryCrosswalkLimit: The approximate point falls inside Hylak_id 1397813, but the source polygon has no lake name and no independent authoritative map crosswalk was established. Neither nearby polygon is assigned to Lake Sampaloc.

limitations: HydroLAKES v1 aims to map lakes and reservoirs at least 10 hectares; smaller lakes, ponds, wetlands and other inland waters are not comprehensively represented.
This derived Asia subset is a discovery aid, not an official Philippine national waterbody inventory. Its raw archive is retained only in ignored local research storage.
The two nearby features have empty Lake_name fields. Spatial overlap with an approximate point does not establish the waterbody identity or validate a boundary.
The GBIF search uses one unnamed candidate polygon and the class Actinopterygii filter. A zero result is not evidence of fish absence, a complete survey, or a complete lake occurrence search.
No occurrence records, species names, diet claims, current-presence statements, access claims, or app geometry were admitted.
attribution: HydroLAKES v1, HydroSHEDS/HydroRIVERS-HydroBASINS source dataset by Lehner and Messager (2016), CC BY 4.0; Asia subset by Daniel Schönberger (2025), Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17503891, CC BY 4.0.
nextAction: Crosswalk Hylak_id 1397813 against an independent authoritative or reusable San Pablo map before assigning it to Lake Sampaloc. Keep the polygon research-only unless identity, positional suitability, attribution, and app reuse are reviewed.
